name: treg
description: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn
one_liner: One subscription that gives an AI agent access to thousands of paid data and tool services — company lookups, SEO data, image generation — billed by the call, so nobody has to sign up for dozens of separate accounts.
buyer: A solo builder or small agency running AI agents that need occasional access to expensive data APIs (Semrush, Crunchbase, Apollo) but can't justify a $99–$139/month subscription to each one for occasional use.
business_use_cases: A one-person lead-gen agency queries company enrichment data per-lead through treg instead of paying for a full Apollo seat.
A content agency's AI agent pulls backlink and trend data per report instead of the agency buying a Semrush license nobody uses daily.
A dev team registers their own paid API keys and internal CLIs (Stripe, GitHub) so every teammate's agent can use them without ever seeing the credentials.

money_ideas.idea: This is treg's own business model — self-hosting it and reselling metered access to a curated tool set for a specific vertical (e.g. real-estate data) is a direct copy-the-idea play.
Offer a done-for-you 'connect your team's tools to your AI agents safely' setup service.

steal_this: Self-host it for a small team this weekend, register three or four paid tools everyone already pays for individually, and immediately cut everyone's per-seat vendor bill.
